clauses.reason: The operative paragraph of Executive Order 8327 exempts Dr. Mary B. Harris from compulsory retirement for age under section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932, for a term it states as 'for a period of one year ending March 31, 1941'. The exemption is a fixed-term command, so it ends by its own terms on the stated date, 1941-03-31. The date is recorded inclusive, as the exemption runs through the end of March 31, 1941; the exclusive reading, under which the term ends when that day begins, is the alternative. The grant is personal to one named person and nothing in the held text makes it depend on a report, an event or a later order.
